```
import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Session, User } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';

type AuthContextType = {
  session: Session | null;
  user: User | null;
  loading: boolean;
  signUp: (email: string, password: string, displayName: string) => Promise<{ error: Error | null }>;
  signIn: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<{ error: Error | null }>;
  signOut: () => Promise<{ error: Error | null }>;
  deleteAccount: () => Promise<{ error: Error | null }>;
};

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

const arabicToEnglishMap: Record<string, string> = {
  'أ': 'a', 'ا': 'a', 'إ': 'a', 'آ': 'a',
  'ب': 'b',
  'ت': 't',
  'ث': 'th',
  'ج': 'j',
  'ح': 'h',
  'خ': 'kh',
  'د': 'd',
  'ذ': 'dh',
  'ر': 'r',
  'ز': 'z',
  'س': 's',
  'ش': 'sh',
  'ص': 's',
  'ض': 'd',
  'ط': 't',
  'ظ': 'z',
  'ع': 'a',
  'غ': 'gh',
  'ف': 'f',
  'ق': 'q',
  'ك': 'k',
  'ل': 'l',
  'م': 'm',
  'ن': 'n',
  'هـ': 'h', 'ه': 'h',
  'و': 'w',
  'ي': 'y',
  'ة': 'a',
  'ء': 'a',
  'ئ': 'a',
  'ؤ': 'w'
};

function transliterateArabicToEnglish(text: string): string {
  let result = '';
  for (const char of text) {
    result += arabicToEnglishMap[char] || char;
  }
  return result;
}

function normalizeName(name: string): string {
  let normalized = transliterateArabicToEnglish(name);
  normalized = normalized.toLowerCase();
  normalized = normalized.replace(/\s+/g, '_');
  normalized = normalized.replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, '');
  return normalized;
}

async function generateUniqueUsername(firstName: string, lastName: string): Promise<string> {
  const normalizedFirst = normalizeName(firstName);
  const normalizedLast = normalizeName(lastName);
  let baseUsername = `${normalizedFirst}_${normalizedLast}`.replace(/_+/g, '_').replace(/^_|_$/g, '');
  
  if (!baseUsername) {
    baseUsername = 'user';
  }

  let username = baseUsername;
  let exists = true;
  let attempts = 0;

  while (exists && attempts < 10) {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('username')
      .eq('username', username)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error) {
      console.error('Error checking username:', error);
      break;
    }

    if (!data) {
      exists = false;
    } else {
      username = `${baseUsername}_${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
    }
    attempts++;
  }

  return username;
}

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [session, setSession] = useState<Session | null>(null);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    supabase.auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session } }) => {
      setSession(session);
      setUser(session?.user ?? null);
      setLoading(false);
    });

    const { data: { subscription } } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
      setSession(session);
      setUser(session?.user ?? null);
      setLoading(false);
    });

    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  const signUp = async (email: string, password: string, displayName: string) => {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
      email,
      password,
      options: {
        data: {
          display_name: displayName,
        },
      },
    });
    if (error) return { error };
    
    if (data.user) {
      const nameParts = displayName.trim().split(/\s+/);
      const firstName = nameParts[0] || '';
      const lastName = nameParts.slice(1).join(' ') || '';
      
      const finalUsername = await generateUniqueUsername(firstName, lastName);

      await supabase.from('profiles').upsert({
        id: data.user.id,
        username: finalUsername,
        display_name: displayName,
      });
    }
    return { error: null };
  };

  const signIn = async (email: string, password: string) => {
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
    return { error };
  };

  const signOut = async () => {
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut();
    return { error };
  };

  const deleteAccount = async () => {
    const { error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('delete-account');
    if (error) return { error };
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    return { error: null };
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ session, user, loading, signUp, signIn, signOut, deleteAccount }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useAuth() {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
}
```

```
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2'
import { corsHeaders } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2/cors'

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: corsHeaders })

  try {
    const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization')
    if (!authHeader?.startsWith('Bearer ')) return json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, 401)

    const userClient = createClient(
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!,
      { global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } } },
    )

    const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await userClient.auth.getUser()
    if (userErr || !userData?.user) return json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, 401)
    const user = userData.user

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => null)
    const password = typeof body?.password === 'string' ? body.password : ''
    if (!password) return json({ error: 'Password required' }, 400)
    if (!user.email) return json({ error: 'Account has no email' }, 400)

    // Verify the celebrity's password.
    const verifyClient = createClient(
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!,
    )
    const { error: signInErr } = await verifyClient.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email: user.email,
      password,
    })
    if (signInErr) return json({ error: 'Invalid password' }, 403)

    const admin = createClient(
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!,
    )

    // Capture currently-active managers so we can log each revocation.
    const { data: activeLinks } = await admin
      .from('manager_links')
      .select('manager_id')
      .eq('celebrity_id', user.id)
      .eq('status', 'active')

    const { data: revokedCount, error: rpcErr } = await admin
      .rpc('kill_switch_revoke_all', { _celebrity: user.id })

    if (rpcErr) {
      console.error('kill switch error', rpcErr)
      return json({ error: 'Could not revoke managers' }, 500)
    }

    // Also invalidate any pending invitations.
    await admin
      .from('manager_invitations')
      .update({ status: 'revoked' })
      .eq('celebrity_id', user.id)
      .eq('status', 'pending')

    // Log one activity entry per revoked manager.
    if (activeLinks?.length) {
      await admin.from('manager_activity_log').insert(
        activeLinks.map((l: { manager_id: string }) => ({
          celebrity_id: user.id,
          manager_id: l.manager_id,
          action: 'kill_switch',
          detail: 'تم سحب كل الصلاحيات فوراً',
        })),
      )

      // Clear active_celebrity_id for every revoked manager so their
      // dashboard no longer points to this celebrity.
      const revokedIds = activeLinks.map((l: { manager_id: string }) => l.manager_id)
      await admin
        .from('profiles')
        .update({ active_celebrity_id: null })
        .in('id', revokedIds)
        .eq('active_celebrity_id', user.id)
    }

    return json({ revoked: revokedCount ?? 0 }, 200)
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e)
    return json({ error: 'Internal error' }, 500)
  }
})

function json(payload: unknown, status: number) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), {
    headers: { ...corsHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    status,
  })
}
```

```
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2'
import { corsHeaders } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2/cors'
import { customAlphabet } from 'npm:nanoid@5'

// Code: 8 unambiguous uppercase chars. Token: 16 url-safe chars for the link.
const codeGen = customAlphabet('ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789', 8)
const tokenGen = customAlphabet('0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ', 16)

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: corsHeaders })

  try {
    const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization')
    if (!authHeader?.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
      return json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, 401)
    }

    const userClient = createClient(
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!,
      { global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } } },
    )

    const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await userClient.auth.getUser()
    if (userErr || !userData?.user) return json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, 401)
    const user = userData.user

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => null)
    const password = typeof body?.password === 'string' ? body.password : ''
    if (!password || password.length < 1) return json({ error: 'Password required' }, 400)
    if (!user.email) return json({ error: 'Account has no email' }, 400)

    // Verify the celebrity's password by re-authenticating on a throwaway client.
    const verifyClient = createClient(
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!,
    )
    const { error: signInErr } = await verifyClient.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email: user.email,
      password,
    })
    if (signInErr) return json({ error: 'Invalid password' }, 403)

    // Service-role client to write the invitation securely.
    const admin = createClient(
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!,
    )

    // Invalidate any previous pending invites from this celebrity.
    await admin
      .from('manager_invitations')
      .update({ status: 'revoked' })
      .eq('celebrity_id', user.id)
      .eq('status', 'pending')

    let code = codeGen()
    const token = tokenGen()
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() // 15 minutes

    const { data: inserted, error: insErr } = await admin
      .from('manager_invitations')
      .insert({ celebrity_id: user.id, code, token, expires_at: expiresAt, status: 'pending' })
      .select('code, token, expires_at')
      .single()

    if (insErr) {
      console.error('insert error', insErr)
      return json({ error: 'Could not create invitation' }, 500)
    }

    return json({
      code: inserted.code,
      token: inserted.token,
      expires_at: inserted.expires_at,
    }, 200)
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e)
    return json({ error: 'Internal error' }, 500)
  }
})

function json(payload: unknown, status: number) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), {
    headers: { ...corsHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    status,
  })
}
```

```
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2'
import { corsHeaders } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2/cors'

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: corsHeaders })

  try {
    const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization')
    if (!authHeader?.startsWith('Bearer ')) return json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, 401)

    const userClient = createClient(
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!,
      { global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } } },
    )
    const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await userClient.auth.getUser()
    if (userErr || !userData?.user) return json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, 401)
    const manager = userData.user

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => null)
    const raw = typeof body?.code === 'string' ? body.code.trim() : ''
    const token = typeof body?.token === 'string' ? body.token.trim() : ''
    if (!raw && !token) return json({ error: 'Code required' }, 400)

    const admin = createClient(
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!,
    )

    const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5

    // Match by token (from link) or by code, must be pending + not expired + not locked.
    let query = admin
      .from('manager_invitations')
      .select('id, celebrity_id, expires_at, status, code, token, failed_attempts')
      .eq('status', 'pending')
      .gt('expires_at', new Date().toISOString())
      .lt('failed_attempts', MAX_ATTEMPTS)
      .limit(1)

    query = token ? query.eq('token', token) : query.ilike('code', raw)

    const { data: invite, error: findErr } = await query.maybeSingle()
    if (findErr) { console.error(findErr); return json({ error: 'Lookup failed' }, 500) }
    if (!invite) return json({ error: 'Invalid or expired invitation' }, 404)

    // If both token and code provided, ensure code matches; count failed tries and lock out.
    if (token && raw && invite.code.toUpperCase() !== raw.toUpperCase()) {
      const attempts = (invite.failed_attempts ?? 0) + 1
      await admin
        .from('manager_invitations')
        .update({
          failed_attempts: attempts,
          status: attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS ? 'revoked' : 'pending',
        })
        .eq('id', invite.id)
      return json({ error: 'Code does not match' }, 403)
    }

    if (invite.celebrity_id === manager.id) {
      return json({ error: "You can't manage yourself" }, 400)
    }


    // Create / reactivate the manager link.
    const { error: linkErr } = await admin
      .from('manager_links')
      .upsert(
        { celebrity_id: invite.celebrity_id, manager_id: manager.id, status: 'active' },
        { onConflict: 'celebrity_id,manager_id' },
      )
    if (linkErr) { console.error(linkErr); return json({ error: 'Could not link manager' }, 500) }

    // Mark invitation used.
    await admin
      .from('manager_invitations')
      .update({ status: 'used', used_by: manager.id })
      .eq('id', invite.id)

    // Audit log: a new manager joined.
    await admin.from('manager_activity_log').insert({
      celebrity_id: invite.celebrity_id,
      manager_id: manager.id,
      action: 'manager_joined',
      detail: 'Manager accepted invitation',
    })


    // Return celebrity info for confirmation UI.
    const { data: celeb } = await admin
      .from('profiles')
      .select('display_name, username')
      .eq('id', invite.celebrity_id)
      .maybeSingle()

    return json({
      celebrity_id: invite.celebrity_id,
      celebrity: celeb ?? null,
    }, 200)
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e)
    return json({ error: 'Internal error' }, 500)
  }
})

function json(payload: unknown, status: number) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), {
    headers: { ...corsHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    status,
  })
}
```

```
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2'
import { corsHeaders } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2/cors'

// Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account:
// 1) wipes all their app data (public schema) via the security-definer RPC
// 2) deletes the auth.users row itself so the account is truly gone and the
//    email can be reused for a fresh signup.
Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response('ok', { headers: corsHeaders })

  try {
    const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization')
    if (!authHeader?.startsWith('Bearer ')) return json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, 401)

    const userClient = createClient(
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY')!,
      { global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } } },
    )
    const { data: userData, error: userErr } = await userClient.auth.getUser()
    if (userErr || !userData?.user) return json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, 401)
    const user = userData.user

    const admin = createClient(
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!,
      Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!,
    )

    // 1) Wipe all app data. The RPC enforces auth.uid() = _user_id, so run it as the user.
    const { error: wipeErr } = await userClient.rpc('delete_user_data', { _user_id: user.id })
    if (wipeErr) {
      console.error('data wipe error', wipeErr)
      return json({ error: 'Could not delete account data' }, 500)
    }

    // 2) Permanently delete the auth user (frees the email for re-registration).
    const { error: delErr } = await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(user.id)
    if (delErr) {
      console.error('auth delete error', delErr)
      return json({ error: 'Could not remove account' }, 500)
    }

    return json({ deleted: true }, 200)
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e)
    return json({ error: 'Internal error' }, 500)
  }
})

function json(payload: unknown, status: number) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), {
    headers: { ...corsHeaders, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    status,
  })
}
```

```
/**
 * E2E Key Manager — handles key generation, encrypted-at-rest storage,
 * per-device key registration, and message encrypt/decrypt with detailed status.
 * Includes retry mechanism and recovery flow for improved reliability.
 */
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import {
  generateKeyPair,
  encryptMessage,
  decryptMessage,
  isEncryptedMessage,
  storeKeysSecure,
  getStoredKeysSecure,
  clearKeysSecure,
  migrateLegacyKeysIfPresent,
} from './encryption';
import { getOrCreateDeviceSecret, getOrCreateDeviceId, encryptSessionState, decryptSessionState } from './cryptoHelpers';
import { setCloudSyncHandler, getSession } from './signalProtocol';

export type EncryptResult =
  | { success: true; payload: string }
  | { success: false; reason: 'no_local_keys' | 'recipient_no_e2e' | 'encryption_failed' };

export type DecryptResult =
  | { success: true; plaintext: string }
  | { success: false; reason: 'not_encrypted' | 'no_local_keys' | 'sender_no_key' | 'decryption_failed' };

const MAX_RETRIES = 3;
const RETRY_DELAY_MS = 300;

async function withRetry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, retries = MAX_RETRIES): Promise<T> {
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= retries; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (err) {
      if (attempt === retries) throw err;
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, RETRY_DELAY_MS * attempt));
    }
  }
  throw new Error('Max retries exceeded');
}

// Initialize E2E keys on login. Encrypted at rest. Registers public key in device_keys
// (does NOT overwrite profiles.public_key — each device gets its own row).
export async function initE2EKeys(userId: string, password?: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    // 1. Migrate any legacy plaintext keys.
    await migrateLegacyKeysIfPresent();

    const passphrase = getOrCreateDeviceSecret();
    const deviceId = getOrCreateDeviceId();

    let keys = await getStoredKeysSecure(passphrase);

    if (!keys) {
      keys = await generateKeyPair();
      await storeKeysSecure(keys.publicKey, keys.privateKey, passphrase);
    }

    // Upsert this device's public key with retry (one row per device, never overwrites others).
    await withRetry(async () => {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('device_keys' as any)
        .upsert(
          {
            user_id: userId,
            device_id: deviceId,
            public_key: keys!.publicKey,
            last_seen: new Date().toISOString(),
          },
          { onConflict: 'user_id,device_id' }
        );
      if (error) throw error;
    });

    // Backwards compatibility: ensure profiles.public_key has *some* key so older
    // recipients (that read profiles.public_key) can still encrypt to us. Only set
    // if missing, never overwrite.
    await withRetry(async () => {
      const { data: profile } = await supabase
        .from('profiles')
        .select('public_key')
        .eq('id', userId)
        .single();
      if (!profile?.public_key) {
        await supabase.from('profiles').update({ public_key: keys!.publicKey }).eq('id', userId);
      }
    });

    // Restore cloud sessions if password is provided
    if (password) {
      await restoreCloudSessions(userId, password);
    }

    // Setup cloud sync handler
    setCloudSyncHandler(async (partnerId, state) => {
      if (!password) return { success: false, conflict: false };
      const encryptedState = await encryptSessionState(JSON.stringify(state), password);
      
      // Optimistic concurrency: check current version and update conditionally
      const { data: current } = await (supabase as any)
        .from('ratchet_sessions')
        .select('state_version')
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .eq('partner_id', partnerId)
        .single();

      const currentVersion = current?.state_version || 0;
      const newVersion = state.version || 0;

      if (newVersion < currentVersion) {
        return { success: false, conflict: true };
      }

      const { error } = await (supabase as any).from('ratchet_sessions').upsert({
        user_id: userId,
        partner_id: partnerId,
        encrypted_state: encryptedState,
        state_version: newVersion,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }, { onConflict: 'user_id,partner_id' });

      if (error) {
        console.warn('[E2E] Cloud sync upsert failed', error);
        return { success: false, conflict: false };
      }
      return { success: true, conflict: false };
    });

  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[E2E] initE2EKeys failed, will retry on next login', e);
  }
}

// Restore sessions from cloud
async function restoreCloudSessions(userId: string, password: string) {
  try {
    const { data: cloudSessions } = await (supabase as any)
      .from('ratchet_sessions')
      .select('partner_id, encrypted_state, state_version')
      .eq('user_id', userId);

    if (!cloudSessions || cloudSessions.length === 0) return;

    const localSessions = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('directly_ratchet_sessions') || '{}');

    for (const cs of cloudSessions) {
      try {
        const decryptedStateStr = await decryptSessionState(cs.encrypted_state, password);
        const cloudState = JSON.parse(decryptedStateStr);
        
        const localState = localSessions[cs.partner_id];
        
        // Conflict resolution: adopt the state with the higher version
        if (!localState || (cloudState.version || 0) > (localState.version || 0)) {
          localSessions[cs.partner_id] = cloudState;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[E2E] Failed to decrypt/restore session for partner', cs.partner_id, e);
      }
    }

    localStorage.setItem('directly_ratchet_sessions', JSON.stringify(localSessions));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[E2E] restoreCloudSessions failed', e);
  }
}

// Get recipient's most-recently-seen device public key (fallback to profile).
export async function getRecipientPublicKey(recipientId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const result = (await withRetry(() =>
      (supabase as any)
        .from('device_keys')
        .select('public_key, last_seen')
        .eq('user_id', recipientId)
        .order('last_seen', { ascending: false })
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle()
        .then((r: any) => r)
    )) as any;
    if (result?.data?.public_key) return result.data.public_key;
  } catch {
    /* fall through to profile key */
  }
  try {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('public_key').eq('id', recipientId).single();
    return data?.public_key || null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// Encrypt — returns explicit status. Caller must handle failure (no silent plaintext fallback).
export async function encryptForRecipient(content: string, recipientId: string): Promise<EncryptResult> {
  const keys = await getStoredKeysSecure();
  if (!keys) return { success: false, reason: 'no_local_keys' };

  const recipientPubKey = await getRecipientPublicKey(recipientId);
  if (!recipientPubKey) return { success: false, reason: 'recipient_no_e2e' };

  try {
    const payload = await encryptMessage(content, keys.privateKey, recipientPubKey);
    return { success: true, payload };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[E2E] encryption_failed', err);
    return { success: false, reason: 'encryption_failed' };
  }
}

export async function decryptFromSender(content: string, senderId: string): Promise<DecryptResult> {
  if (!isEncryptedMessage(content)) return { success: false, reason: 'not_encrypted' };

  const keys = await getStoredKeysSecure();
  if (!keys) return { success: false, reason: 'no_local_keys' };

  const senderPubKey = await getRecipientPublicKey(senderId);
  if (!senderPubKey) return { success: false, reason: 'sender_no_key' };

  try {
    const plaintext = await decryptMessage(content, keys.privateKey, senderPubKey);
    return { success: true, plaintext };
  } catch (err) {
    // Try all known device keys for this sender as fallback
    try {
      const { data: deviceKeys } = await supabase
        .from('device_keys' as any)
        .select('public_key')
        .eq('user_id', senderId)
        .order('last_seen', { ascending: false });

      const allKeys: any[] = deviceKeys ?? [];
      for (const dk of allKeys) {
        if (!dk.public_key || dk.public_key === senderPubKey) continue;
        try {
          const plaintext = await decryptMessage(content, keys.privateKey, dk.public_key);
          return { success: true, plaintext };
        } catch {
          continue;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
    console.error('[E2E] decryption_failed', err);
    return { success: false, reason: 'decryption_failed' };
  }
}

// Re-initialize keys from scratch (recovery flow).
export async function recoverE2EKeys(userId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const passphrase = getOrCreateDeviceSecret();
    const deviceId = getOrCreateDeviceId();

    const keys = await generateKeyPair();
    await storeKeysSecure(keys.publicKey, keys.privateKey, passphrase);

    await supabase
      .from('device_keys' as any)
      .upsert(
        {
          user_id: userId,
          device_id: deviceId,
          public_key: keys.publicKey,
          last_seen: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        { onConflict: 'user_id,device_id' }
      );

    await supabase.from('profiles').update({ public_key: keys.publicKey }).eq('id', userId);
    return { success: true };
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('[E2E] recovery failed', e);
    return { success: false, error: e?.message ?? 'Unknown error' };
  }
}

export async function clearE2EKeysOnSignOut(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await clearKeysSecure();
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[E2E] clearKeysSecure failed on sign-out', e);
  }
}
```

## Critical Issues Found

### 1. **`useRole.tsx` - Missing return values** (Runtime crash)
`SovereignRolePanel.tsx` destructures `accountType, role, managedCelebrityId` from `useRole()`, but the hook only returns `{ loading, refresh }`.

### 2. **`useAuth.tsx` - Type syntax errors** (Build failure)

### 3. **Duplicate `use-toast.ts`** - Two identical files at different paths causing import ambiguity.

## Fixes

### Fix 1: `artifacts\sovereign\src\hooks\useRole.tsx`
```tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';

export function useRole() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [accountType, setAccountType] = useState<'celebrity' | 'sender' | null>(null);
  const [role, setRole] = useState<'celebrity' | 'manager' | 'user' | null>(null);
  const [managedCelebrityId, setManagedCelebrityId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fetchRole = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!user) {
      setAccountType(null);
      setRole(null);
      setManagedCelebrityId(null);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const { data: profile } = await supabase
        .from('profiles')
        .select('account_type, managed_celebrity_id')
        .eq('id', user.id)
        .single();

      if (profile) {
        setAccountType(profile.account_type as 'celebrity' | 'sender' | null);
        setManagedCelebrityId(profile.managed_celebrity_id);
        setRole(profile.managed_celebrity_id ? 'manager' : (profile.account_type === 'celebrity' ? 'celebrity' : 'user'));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to fetch role', e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [user]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchRole();
  }, [fetchRole]);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    await fetchRole();
  }, [fetchRole]);

  return { loading, refresh, accountType, role, managedCelebrityId };
}
```

| `manager-kill-switch` | User (celebrity) + password verify | RPC `kill_switch_revoke_all`, révoque invitations, log, clear active_celebrity_id |
| `delete-account` | User | RPC `delete_user_data` + admin.auth.admin.deleteUser |
| `classify-message` | Anon/Service | Classification spam/filter → { category, blocked, reason } |
| `send-push-notification` | Service | Envoi push (détails non vus) |

### 1.6 E2E Encryption Flow (e2eManager.ts)

```
initE2EKeys(userId, password?)
  ├── migrateLegacyKeysIfPresent()
  ├── getOrCreateDeviceSecret() → device secret stable
  ├── getOrCreateDeviceId() → device ID stable
  ├── getStoredKeysSecure(passphrase) → { publicKey, privateKey } depuis localStorage chiffré
  │     └── Si absent: generateKeyPair() (Web Crypto: ECDH P-256 + AES-GCM)
  ├── Upsert device_keys (user_id, device_id, public_key, last_seen)
  ├── Backfill profiles.public_key si vide (compat)
  ├── Si password: restoreCloudSessions() → ratchet_sessions
  └── setCloudSyncHandler() pour Signal Protocol

encryptForRecipient(content, recipientId)
  ├── getStoredKeysSecure() → local keys
  ├── getRecipientPublicKey(recipientId)
  │     ├── device_keys ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 1
  │     └── FALLBACK: profiles.public_key
  └── encryptMessage(content, myPrivateKey, theirPublicKey) → payload chiffré

decryptFromSender(content, senderId)
  ├── isEncryptedMessage(content) check
  ├── getStoredKeysSecure() → local keys
  ├── getRecipientPublicKey(senderId) → leur clé publique
  ├── decryptMessage(content, myPrivateKey, theirPublicKey)
  └── FALLBACK: essaie toutes device_keys du sender

recoverE2EKeys(userId) → régénère tout, upsert device_keys + profiles.public_key
clearE2EKeysOnSignOut() → clearKeysSecure()
```

**Dépendances crypto** (importées mais non fournies):
- `./encryption` → generateKeyPair, encryptMessage, decryptMessage, isEncryptedMessage, storeKeysSecure, getStoredKeysSecure, clearKeysSecure, migrateLegacyKeysIfPresent
- `./cryptoHelpers` → getOrCreateDeviceSecret, getOrCreateDeviceId, encryptSessionState, decryptSessionState
- `./signalProtocol` → setCloudSyncHandler, getSession

```
Database Tables (inférées)
```

## 2. FLUX INTENTIONNEL (INFÉRÉ)

| Étape | Intention |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Email/password + username auto-généré unique (translittération arabe) |
| **Rôles** | User → peut devenir Celebrity (full inboxes) ou Sender (envoi seulement) |
| **Celebrity** | Invite managers (code + lien), révoque individuel ou kill-switch total |
| **Manager** | Gère UNE celebrity, voit seulement inbox "work" |
| **Messaging** | 3 catégories: work (managers), audience (public), direct (whitelist) |
| **Smart routing** | Thread par catégorie, déduction crédit si conversation active < 1h |
| **Limites** | Celebrity configure inbox_mode (open/limited/closed/unlimited) par catégorie |
| **E2E** | Double ratchet (Signal) + cloud sync sessions chiffrées par password |
| **Media** | Upload direct vers Supabase Storage, URL publique dans message |
| **Push** | Notification avec conversationId pour deep link |

### BLOCKER #1: `useAuth.tsx` - Syntax Error TypeScript

- **Fix minimal**: Ajouter `>` après `null }`
- **Impact**: Frontend (build)

### BLOCKER #2: `useRole.tsx` - Valeurs de retour manquantes

- **Problème**: Hook retourne `{ loading, refresh }` mais `SovereignRolePanel.tsx` destructure `accountType, role, managedCelebrityId`
- **Pourquoi bloque**: Runtime crash `undefined is not iterable` ou `Cannot destructure property 'accountType'`

## 1. `classify-message` - ANALYSE DE L'APPEL DANS `MessageComposer.tsx`

### Code appelant (lignes 135-155) :
```typescript
const { data: classData } = await supabase.functions.invoke('classify-message', {
  body: { content: text || 'Voice message', senderId, receiverId: recipient.id },
});

// Sender transparency: blocked by recipient's filter or spam/toxicity
if (classData?.blocked) {
  const reasonMsg = classData.message || (
    classData.reason === 'filter'
      ? (isRTL ? `لم تصل رسالتك — المستلم لا يستقبل رسائل من نوع: ${classData.filter_type}` : `Your message was not delivered — recipient doesn't accept ${classData.filter_type} messages.`)
      : classData.reason === 'spam'
        ? (isRTL ? 'لم تصل رسالتك — اعتُبرت سبام.' : 'Your message was not delivered — flagged as spam.')
        : (isRTL ? 'لم تصل رسالتك — تحتوي محتوى غير مسموح.' : 'Your message was not delivered — contains disallowed content.')
  );
  toast.error(reasonMsg, { duration: 5000 });
  setIsSending(false);
  return;
}

category = classData?.category || 'audience';
if (category === 'direct') category = 'audience';
```

### Ce que le code **attend** comme réponse :
```typescript
interface ClassifyResponse {
  category: 'work' | 'audience' | 'direct';  // OBLIGATOIRE (fallback 'audience')
  blocked?: boolean;                          // OPTIONNEL
  reason?: 'filter' | 'spam' | 'toxicity';    // SI blocked=true
  filter_type?: string;                       // SI reason='filter'
  message?: string;                           // Message custom optionnel
}
```

### Logique métier déduite :
1. **Classification** : Détermine la catégorie (`work`/`audience`/`direct`) basée sur contenu + relation sender/receiver
2. **Filtrage destinataire** : Vérifie `recipient_filters` table (créée dans migration `20260502081155_4426d794-6422-40fd-ad60-dd96aa1880ff.sql`)
3. **Anti-spam/toxicité** : Analyse contenu
4. **Bloquage** : Si `blocked=true` → **arrêt total de l'envoi** (return early), toast erreur, pas d'insert en DB

### Statut réel : **MANQUANTE** (aucune Edge Function fournie, aucune migration ne la crée)

## 3. `can_receive_message` - TRACE COMPLÈTE DANS MIGRATIONS

### Migration `20260109103116_31974e0c-f38e-4313-b643-e76a68eb2415.sql` (lignes 140-160) :
```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_receive_message(
  _user_id UUID,
  _category message_category
)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT get_message_count(_user_id, _category) < COALESCE(
      (SELECT max_messages FROM public.message_limits 
       WHERE user_id = _user_id AND category = _category),
      100
    )),
    true
  );
$$;
```

### Elle **EXISTE** dans cette migration (ligne 140-160) ! 
**Mon rapport précédent était INCORRECT** - je l'avais manquée car elle est dans la même migration que la création des tables.

### Dépendances de cette fonction :
1. `get_message_count(_user_id, _category)` - **EXISTE** (lignes 125-135)
2. `message_limits` table - **CRÉÉE** lignes 15-20
3. `message_category` enum - **CRÉÉ** ligne 1

### Migration `20260502081155_4426d794-6422-40fd-ad60-dd96aa1880ff.sql` - AJOUTE `inbox_mode` :
```sql
-- Ajoute colonne inbox_mode sur message_limits
ALTER TABLE public.message_limits ADD COLUMN inbox_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'limited';
```

### **MAIS** : La fonction `can_receive_message` **N'A PAS ÉTÉ MISE À JOUR** pour tenir compte de `inbox_mode` !
- Elle ne vérifie que `max_messages` vs count
- Ignore `inbox_mode = 'closed'` ou `'unlimited'`

### Code dans `MessageComposer.tsx` (lignes 155-175) **COMPENSE** côté client :
```typescript
const { data: limitRow } = await supabase
  .from('message_limits')
  .select('inbox_mode, max_messages')
  .eq('user_id', recipient.id)
  .eq('category', category)
  .maybeSingle();

if (limitRow?.inbox_mode === 'closed' || limitRow?.max_messages === 0) {
  toast.error(...); setIsSending(false); return;
}

if (limitRow?.inbox_mode !== 'unlimited') {
  const { data: canReceive } = await supabase.rpc('can_receive_message', {
    _user_id: recipient.id, _category: category,
  });
  if (!canReceive) { toast.error(...); setIsSending(false); return; }
}
```

### Conclusion : **Fonction EXISTE en DB** mais **LOGIQUE INCOMPLÈTE** (pas de inbox_mode). Le frontend compense.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kill_switch_revoke_all(_celebrity uuid)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE n integer;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.manager_links
  SET status = 'revoked', updated_at = now()
  WHERE celebrity_id = _celebrity AND status = 'active';
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN n;
END;
$$;
```

## 5. PARCOURS COMPLET MESSAGE - POINTS D'ARRÊT RÉELS

```
MessageComposer.sendMessage()
│
├─ 1. Upload media (si mediaPreview) → supabase.storage.upload()
│   └─ ÉCHEC → return (pas d'erreur toast explicite)
│
├─ 2. Vérification direct_access
│   └─ Si existe → category = 'direct'
│
├─ 3. SI PAS direct_access → classify-message Edge Function
│   ├─ ÉCHEC RÉSEAU → classData = undefined → category = 'audience' (fallback)
│   ├─ blocked=true → TOAST ERROR + RETURN (ARRÊT TOTAL)
│   └─ OK → category = classData.category || 'audience'
│
├─ 4. Smart routing (recherche thread parent_id IS NULL)
│   └─ Déduit shouldDeductCredit selon dernier message < 1h
│
├─ 5. SI shouldDeductCredit → Vérifications limites
│   ├─ SELECT message_limits (inbox_mode, max_messages)
│   ├─ inbox_mode='closed' ou max_messages=0 → TOAST + RETURN (ARRÊT)
│   ├─ inbox_mode!='unlimited' → RPC can_receive_message
│   │   └─ false → TOAST + RETURN (ARRÊT)
│   └─ (Note: RPC ignore inbox_mode, mais frontend vérifie avant)
│
├─ 6. Chiffrement E2E
│   ├─ encryptForRecipient(content, recipientId)
│   │   ├─ getStoredKeysSecure() → null → {success:false, reason:'no_local_keys'} → TOAST + RETURN
│   │   ├─ getRecipientPublicKey() → null → {success:false, reason:'recipient_no_e2e'} → TOAST + RETURN
│   │   └─ encryptMessage() → throw → {success:false, reason:'encryption_failed'} → TOAST + RETURN
│   └─ SUCCÈS → encryptedContent
│
├─ 7. INSERT messages table
│   └─ ÉCHEC → catch → TOAST ERROR + RETURN
│
├─ 8. Push notification (fire-and-forget, .catch(()=>{}))
│   └─ ÉCHEC → SILENCIEUX, message déjà envoyé
│
└─ 9. Toast success + close + onMessageSent()
```

### **POINTS D'ARRÊT RÉELS (Bloquants envoi)** :
| # | Condition | Message utilisateur |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `classify-message` retourne `blocked=true` | "Message non délivré - raison..." |
| 2 | `inbox_mode='closed'` ou `max_messages=0` | "Destinataire a fermé sa boîte..." |
| 3 | `can_receive_message` retourne `false` | "Boîte destinataire pleine" |
| 4 | Pas de clés locales E2E | "Échec chiffrement - message non envoyé" |
| 5 | Destinataire sans clé publique E2E | "Échec chiffrement - message non envoyé" |
| 6 | Erreur chiffrement | "Échec chiffrement - message non envoyé" |
| 7 | Erreur INSERT DB | "Échec envoi" |

### **NON BLOQUANTS** :
- Échec `classify-message` (réseau) → fallback 'audience'
- Échec `send-push-notification` → silencieux
- Pas de `direct_access` → category='audience' (normal)

```
import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Session, User } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';

type AuthContextType = {
  session: Session | null;
  user: User | null;
  loading: boolean;
  signUp: (email: string, password: string, displayName: string) => Promise<{ error: Error | null }>;
  signIn: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<{ error: Error | null }>;
  signOut: () => Promise<{ error: Error | null }>;
  deleteAccount: () => Promise<{ error: Error | null }>;
};

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

function transliterateArabicToEnglish(text: string): string {
  const arabicToEnglishMap: Record<string, string> = {
    'ا': 'a', 'ب': 'b', 'ت': 't', 'ث': 'th', 'ج': 'j', 'ح': 'h', 'خ': 'kh',
    'د': 'd', 'ذ': 'dh', 'ر': 'r', 'ز': 'z', 'س': 's', 'ش': 'sh', 'ص': 's',
    'ض': 'd', 'ط': 't', 'ظ': 'z', 'ع': 'a', 'غ': 'gh', 'ف': 'f', 'ق': 'q',
    'ك': 'k', 'ل': 'l', 'م': 'm', 'ن': 'n', 'ه': 'h', 'و': 'w', 'ي': 'y',
    'ء': '', 'آ': 'a', 'أ': 'a', 'إ': 'i', 'ؤ': 'u', 'ئ': 'i', 'ة': 'h',
    'ى': 'a', 'ك': 'k', 'ي': 'y',
  };
  let result = '';
  for (const char of text) {
    result += arabicToEnglishMap[char] || char;
  }
  return result;
}

function normalizeName(name: string): string {
  let normalized = transliterateArabicToEnglish(name);
  normalized = normalized.toLowerCase();
  normalized = normalized.replace(/\s+/g, '_');
  normalized = normalized.replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, '');
  return normalized;
}

async function generateUniqueUsername(firstName: string, lastName: string): Promise<string> {
  const normalizedFirst = normalizeName(firstName);
  const normalizedLast = normalizeName(lastName);
  let baseUsername = `${normalizedFirst}_${normalizedLast}`.replace(/_+/g, '_').replace(/^_|_$/g, '');
  
  if (!baseUsername) {
    baseUsername = 'user';
  }

  let username = baseUsername;
  let counter = 0;
  while (true) {
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('id')
      .eq('username', username)
      .maybeSingle();
    if (!data) break;
    counter++;
    username = `${baseUsername}_${counter}`;
  }
  return username;
}

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [session, setSession] = useState<Session | null>(null);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    supabase.auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session } }) => {
      setSession(session);
      setUser(session?.user ?? null);
      setLoading(false);
    });

    const { data: { subscription } } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
      setSession(session);
      setUser(session?.user ?? null);
      setLoading(false);
    });

    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  const signUp = async (email: string, password: string, displayName: string) => {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password });
    if (error) return { error };
    if (!data.user) return { error: new Error('Signup failed') };

    const nameParts = displayName.trim().split(/\s+/);
    const firstName = nameParts[0] || '';
    const lastName = nameParts.slice(1).join(' ') || '';
    const username = await generateUniqueUsername(firstName, lastName);

    const { error: profileError } = await supabase.from('profiles').insert({
      id: data.user.id,
      username,
      display_name: displayName,
      account_type: 'sender',
    });
    if (profileError) return { error: profileError };

    return { error: null };
  };

  const signIn = async (email: string, password: string) => {
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
    return { error };
  };

  const signOut = async () => {
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut();
    return { error };
  };

  const deleteAccount = async () => {
    if (!user) return { error: new Error('No user') };
    const { error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('delete-account', {
      body: { password: '' },
    });
    return { error };
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ session, user, loading, signUp, signIn, signOut, deleteAccount }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useAuth() {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
}
```

export function getPublicAppUrl(): string {
  // In production, use the environment variable if set
  if (import.meta.env.VITE_APP_URL) {
    return import.meta.env.VITE_APP_URL;
  }

  // In browser, derive from current location
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {

  // Fallback for SSR/build time

export function buildShareLink(path: string): string {

  if (!base) return path;

  const normalizedPath = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;
  return `${base}${normalizedPath}`;
}

```typescript
/**
 * Public, shareable base URL for Sovereign.
 * Priority:
 *   1. VITE_APP_BASE_URL — explicit build/deploy-time override (custom domain)
 *   2. window.location.origin — the actual domain the app is running on.
 *      We exclude localhost/127.0.0.1 since those aren't publicly reachable.
 */

function envBaseUrl(): string | null {
  const raw = (import.meta as any)?.env?.VITE_APP_BASE_URL;
  if (typeof raw === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(raw.trim())) {
    return raw.trim().replace(/\/$/, '');
  }
  return null;
}

export function getPublicAppUrl(): string {
  const override = envBaseUrl();
  if (override) return override;

  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return '';

  const origin = window.location.origin;

  // Localhost is not publicly reachable — skip it.
  if (origin.includes('localhost') || origin.includes('127.0.0.1')) {
    return '';
  }

  return origin;
}

/** Build a full shareable link to an in-app path (path must start with "/"). */
export function buildShareLink(path: string): string {
  const base = getPublicAppUrl().replace(/\/$/, '');
  const p = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;
  return base ? `${base}${p}` : p;
}
```

## 1. EXISTENCE DU FICHIER `artifacts/sovereign/src/lib/appUrl.ts`

**EXISTE** — Fourni dans la conversation, contenu complet inspecté.

### Exports actuels :
```typescript
export function getPublicAppUrl(): string
export function buildShareLink(path: string): string
```

### Implémentation exacte de `getPublicAppUrl()` :

```typescript
function envBaseUrl(): string | null {
  const raw = (import.meta as any)?.env?.VITE_APP_BASE_URL;
  if (typeof raw === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(raw.trim())) {
    return raw.trim().replace(/\/$/, '');
  }
  return null;
}

export function getPublicAppUrl(): string {
  const override = envBaseUrl();
  if (override) return override;

  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return '';

  const origin = window.location.origin;

  if (origin.includes('localhost') || origin.includes('127.0.0.1')) {
    return '';
  }

  return origin;
}
```

**Logique exacte (ordre de priorité) :**
1. `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` (via `import.meta.env`) — si string valide commençant par `http://` ou `https://` → retourne valeur trimmée sans slash final
2. Sinon, si `window` non défini (SSR) → retourne `''`
3. Sinon, `window.location.origin` — si contient `localhost` ou `127.0.0.1` → retourne `''`
4. Sinon, retourne `window.location.origin` (ex: `https://app.example.com`)

**Variables d'environnement lues :**
- `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` — **seule** variable lue

**Comportement de fallback :**
- Aucun fallback vers `import.meta.env.BASE_URL` ou `VITE_APP_URL`
- Retourne `''` (chaîne vide) en développement (localhost) et en SSR

---

### Implémentation exacte de `buildShareLink(path: string)` :

```typescript
export function buildShareLink(path: string): string {
  const base = getPublicAppUrl().replace(/\/$/, '');
  const p = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;
  return base ? `${base}${p}` : p;
}
```

**Logique exacte :**
1. Appelle `getPublicAppUrl()` → supprime slash final s'il y en a un
2. Normalise `path` : assure un slash initial (`/path` ou `/${path}`)
3. Si `base` non vide → retourne `${base}${p}` (URL absolue)
4. Si `base` vide → retourne `p` (chemin relatif commençant par `/`)

## 5. MISE À JOUR DES FAITS CONFIRMÉS — VERSION FINALE

### FAITS CONFIRMÉS (PROUVÉS PAR TOUS LES FICHIERS INSPECTÉS)

1. **`appUrl.ts` existe** et exporte exactement deux fonctions : `getPublicAppUrl` et `buildShareLink`.

2. **`getPublicAppUrl` lit uniquement `VITE_APP_BASE_URL`** via `import.meta.env`. Aucune autre variable d'environnement n'est lue.

3. **`getPublicAppUrl` retourne `''` (chaîne vide) dans trois cas** :
   - `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` non défini ou invalide + SSR (`window` undefined)
   - `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` non défini ou invalide + `localhost` ou `127.0.0.1` dans l'origine
   - `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` non défini ou invalide + origine non-localhost mais `window` non disponible

4. **`getPublicAppUrl` retourne une URL absolue complète** (ex: `https://app.example.com`) **seulement si** :
   - `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` est valide, **OU**
   - L'application tourne sur un domaine non-localhost en environnement navigateur

5. **`buildShareLink` retourne une URL absolue** (`https://domain.com/path`) **si et seulement si** `getPublicAppUrl()` retourne non-vide. Sinon, retourne un **chemin relatif** commençant par `/` (ex: `/m/token?code=123`).

6. **`CustomLinkCard` utilise `getPublicAppUrl` pour extraire le nom d'hôte** (supprime le protocole via regex). Accepte chaîne vide.

7. **`CustomLinkCard` utilise `buildShareLink` pour deux usages** : affichage UI + copie presse-papiers. Les deux acceptent chemin relatif.

8. **`InviteManagerDialog` utilise `buildShareLink` avec un chemin contenant des paramètres de requête** (`/m/token?code=...`).

9. **`InviteManagerDialog` passe le résultat à `navigator.share({ url: inviteLink })`** — l'API Web Share **exige une URL absolue** selon la spécification.

10. **En développement (localhost), `getPublicAppUrl()` retourne `''`** → `buildShareLink` retourne chemin relatif → `navigator.share` **échouera** (rejet de la promesse avec `TypeError` ou `DOMException`).

11. **`buildShareLink` n'effectue aucune validation** sur le `path` passé : un appel avec `http://evil.com` produirait `http://evil.com` (si base vide) ou `https://app.example.comhttp://evil.com` (si base présente).

12. **`Vite` expose `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` au client** — `envPrefix` par défaut (`VITE_`) non modifié dans `vite.config.ts`.

13. **`BASE_PATH` (process.env) ≠ `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` (import.meta.env)** — deux variables distinctes :
    - `BASE_PATH` : chemin de déploiement (subpath), requis pour `vite.config.ts:base`
    - `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` : URL publique canonique, optionnelle, lue par `appUrl.ts`

14. **`vite.config.ts` n'a PAS de `define`** — aucune injection de `process.env` ou variables custom au client.

15. **Alias `@/*` résout vers `src/*`** — confirmé par `artifacts/sovereign/tsconfig.json` et `vite.config.ts` → `@/lib/appUrl` = `src/lib/appUrl.ts` ✅

16. **Type `import.meta.env` disponible** — `types: ["vite/client"]` dans `tsconfig.json` → `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` typé comme `string | undefined`.

17. **PWA `scope: "/"` et `start_url: "/"`** — relatifs à `base` (donc `BASE_PATH`), **pas** à `VITE_APP_BASE_URL`.

18. **Aucun fichier `.env*` fourni** — valeur réelle de `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` en production **inconnue**.

19. **`FanGroupsManager.tsx` non fourni** — 3ème consommateur potentiel non analysé.

20. **Mode strict TypeScript DÉSACTIVÉ** dans `artifacts/sovereign` — `strict: false` + toutes options strict à `false` → pas d'erreur sur `getPublicAppUrl()` retournant `string` mais pouvant être vide.

#### Problème identifié : **Découplage `BASE_PATH` vs `VITE_APP_BASE_URL`**

| Variable | Utilisation | Disponible client |
|----------|-------------|-------------------|
| `BASE_PATH` (process.env) | `vite.config.ts:base` → `/sovereign/` | **NON** (sauf si `define`) |
| `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` (import.meta.env) | `appUrl.ts:getPublicAppUrl()` → `https://app.example.com` | **OUI** |
| `import.meta.env.BASE_URL` | Vite injecte automatiquement `base` | **OUI** |

**`buildShareLink` n'utilise PAS `import.meta.env.BASE_URL`** — il utilise seulement `getPublicAppUrl()` qui lit `VITE_APP_BASE_URL`.

- Si `BASE_PATH=/sovereign/` et `VITE_APP_BASE_URL=https://app.example.com`
- `buildShareLink('/s/omar')` → `https://app.example.com/s/omar` **SANS `/sovereign/`**
- Route réelle : `https://app.example.com/sovereign/s/omar`
- **LIEN CASSÉ** (404 au hard refresh)

| **Validation croisée** | Si `token` ET `code` fournis → code doit correspondre |
| **Protection brute-force** | `failed_attempts` incrémenté, révoque à 5 échecs |
| **Action** | Upsert dans `manager_links` avec `status: 'active'` |
| **Nettoyage** | Invitation marquée `used` + `used_by` |
| **Audit log** | Insert dans `manager_activity_log` action `manager_joined` |
| **Retour** | `{ celebrity_id, celebrity: { display_name, username } }` |
| **Appelant** | Doit être authentifié (manager) — vérifié via `authHeader` |

```typescript
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    const resolve = async () => {
      if (!slug) {
        navigate('/', { replace: true });
        return;
      }
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from('profiles')
        .select('username')
        .ilike('slug', slug)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (data?.username) {
        navigate(`/@${data.username}`, { replace: true });
      } else {
        navigate('/404', { replace: true });
      }
    };
    resolve();
  }, [slug, navigate]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-background">
      <div className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-primary/30 border-t-primary" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### FAITS CONFIRMÉS — `SlugRedirect`

| Aspect | Détail |
|--------|--------|
| **Paramètre lu** | `params.slug` (via `useParams`) |
| **Résolution** | Requête Supabase directe : `profiles` table, `select('username')`, `.ilike('slug', slug)` |
| **Correspondance** | **Case-insensitive** (`.ilike`) |
| **Redirection** | `navigate(`/@${username}`, { replace: true })` → vers `PublicProfile` |
| **Échec** | `navigate('/404', { replace: true })` |
| **Remplacement historique** | `replace: true` — pas d'entrée dans l'historique pour `/s/...` |
| **Loading** | Spinner pendant résolution |
| **Pas de `buildShareLink`** | N'utilise pas la fonction de partage |

### FLUX `/s/:slug` COMPLET
```
URL: /s/omar (ou /sovereign/s/omar si BASE_PATH)
    ↓
Route React Router: /s/:slug → SlugRedirect
    ↓
SlugRedirect: supabase.from('profiles').select('username').ilike('slug', 'omar')
    ↓
Si trouvé: navigate('/@omar', { replace: true })
    ↓
Route: /:username → PublicProfile (username="omar")
```

## 2. `artifacts/sovereign/src/pages/RedeemManagerInvite.tsx` — RÉSOLUTION `/m/:token?code=`

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import { useRole } from '@/hooks/useRole';
import { useLanguage } from '@/i18n/LanguageContext';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot } from '@/components/ui/input-otp';
import { Crown, Loader2, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

export default function RedeemManagerInvite() {
  const { token } = useParams();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { user, loading } = useAuth();
  const { isRTL } = useLanguage();
  const { switchCelebrity } = useRole();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [code, setCode] = useState(searchParams.get('code') || '');
  const [joining, setJoining] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading && !user) navigate(`/?redirect=/m/${token}`);
  }, [user, loading, token, navigate]);

  const redeem = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    if (code.length < 6) { toast.error(isRTL ? 'أدخل الكود كاملاً' : 'Enter the full code'); return; }
    setJoining(true);
    const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('redeem-manager-invite', {
      body: { token, code },
    });
    setJoining(false);
    if (error || data?.error) {
      toast.error(
        (data?.error || '').toLowerCase().includes('expired')
          ? (isRTL ? 'الدعوة غير صالحة أو منتهية' : 'Invalid or expired invitation')
          : (isRTL ? 'الكود غير صحيح' : 'Incorrect code'),
      );
      return;
    }
    setDone(true);
    if (data?.celebrity_id) {
      await switchCelebrity(data.celebrity_id);
    }
    toast.success(isRTL ? 'أصبحت وكيلاً الآن' : 'You are now a manager');
    setTimeout(() => navigate('/home'), 1200);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-background px-6" dir={isRTL ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}>
      <div className="max-w-sm w-full text-center space-y-6">
        <div className="h-16 w-16 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
          <Crown className="h-8 w-8 text-amber-500" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">{isRTL ? 'دعوة لتكون وكيلاً' : 'Manager Invitation'}</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-2">
            {isRTL ? 'أدخل الكود المكوّن من 6 أرقام لتأكيد الدعوة' : 'Enter the 6-digit code to confirm'}
          </p>
        </div>

        {done ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-emerald-600">
            <Check className="h-5 w-5" /> {isRTL ? 'تم!' : 'Done!'}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex justify-center" dir="ltr">
              <InputOTP maxLength={6} value={code} onChange={(v) => setCode(v.toUpperCase())}>
                <InputOTPGroup>
                  {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
                    <InputOTPSlot key={i} index={i} className="w-9 h-11 text-base font-mono" />
                  ))}
                </InputOTPGroup>
              </InputOTP>
            </div>
            <Button onClick={redeem} disabled={joining || loading} className="w-full h-12 rounded-2xl">
              {joining ? <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin" /> : isRTL ? 'تأكيد وأصبح وكيلاً' : 'Accept & Become Manager'}
            </Button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### FAITS CONFIRMÉS — `RedeemManagerInvite`

| Aspect | Détail |
|--------|--------|
| **Paramètres lus** | `params.token` (path) + `searchParams.get('code')` (query) |
| **Initialisation code** | `useState(searchParams.get('code') || '')` — **lit le query param au montage** |
| **Auth requise** | `useAuth()` → si pas d'utilisateur → redirige `/?redirect=/m/${token}` |
| **Validation code** | Longueur ≥ 6 caractères (le code généré fait 8 chars) |
| **Appel Edge Function** | `supabase.functions.invoke('redeem-manager-invite', { body: { token, code } })` |
| **Gestion erreur** | Vérifie `error` ou `data?.error` — messages localisés |
| **Succès** | `switchCelebrity(data.celebrity_id)` → `navigate('/home')` après 1.2s |
| **UI** | InputOTP 6 slots, bouton confirmation, état loading/done |
| **Pas de `buildShareLink`** | N'utilise pas la fonction de partage |

### FLUX `/m/:token?code=` COMPLET
```
URL: /m/TOKEN123?code=ABC12345 (ou /sovereign/m/TOKEN123?code=ABC12345)
    ↓
Route React Router: /m/:token → RedeemManagerInvite
    ↓
RedeemManagerInvite: 
  - token = useParams().token
  - code = useSearchParams().get('code') → état initial
    ↓
Utilisateur soumet code (ou déjà dans URL)
    ↓
supabase.functions.invoke('redeem-manager-invite', { token, code })
    ↓
Edge Function: valide token+code, crée manager_links, retourne celebrity_id
    ↓
switchCelebrity(celebrity_id) → navigate('/home')
```

## 3. `artifacts/sovereign/src/pages/PublicProfile.tsx` — PAGE PROFIL PUBLIC `/:username`

```typescript
// Imports pertinents
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { useAuth } from '@/hooks/useAuth';
import { useLanguage } from '@/i18n/LanguageContext';
// ... lazy imports MessageComposer, DealCardComposer

interface Profile {
  id: string;
  username: string | null;
  display_name: string | null;
  avatar_url: string | null;
  bio: string | null;
  is_public: boolean | null;
  account_type?: string | null;
}

// Fetch profil (useEffect lignes 68-100)
useEffect(() => {
  const fetchProfile = async () => {
    if (!username) return;
    if (!username.startsWith('@')) { setNotFound(true); setIsLoading(false); return; }
    setIsLoading(true);
    const cleanUsername = username.replace(/^@/, '');

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, bio, is_public, account_type')
      .eq('username', cleanUsername)
      .single();

    if (error || !data) { setNotFound(true); setIsLoading(false); return; }

    setProfile(data as Profile);
    document.title = `${data.display_name || cleanUsername} — Sovereign`;
    setIsLoading(false);
  };
  fetchProfile();
}, [username, language]);

// Gestion avatar (lignes 102-140) — upload/suppression si isOwnProfile

// Partage (lignes 142-155)
const handleShare = () => {
  if (!profile?.username) return;
  const displayName = profile.display_name || profile.username;
  shareCardAsImage(
    'profile-share-card',
    `${displayName} — Sovereign`,
    `Check out ${displayName}'s communication style on Sovereign!\n${window.location.origin}/@${profile.username}`
  );
};

const handleCopyUsername = () => {
  if (!profile?.username) return;
  copyUsername(profile.username, l.usernameCopied);
};

// Boutons action (lignes 180-210)
{user && !isOwnProfile && (
  <Button onClick={() => setShowComposer(true)}>  // Message
    <Send /> {l.sendMessage}
  </Button>
)}
{user && !isOwnProfile && profile?.account_type === 'celebrity' && (
  <Button onClick={() => setShowDealCard(true)}>  // Deal
    <Sparkles /> {language === 'ar' ? 'إرسال عرض عمل' : 'Send Deal'}
  </Button>
)}
{!user && (
  <Button onClick={() => navigate('/')}>  // Join
    <MessageCircle /> {l.joinSovereign}
  </Button>
)}
<Button variant="outline" onClick={handleShare}>  // Share card as image
  <Share2 /> {l.shareProfile}
</Button>
<Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={handleCopyUsername}>  // Copy username
  <Copy />
</Button>

// CTA non connecté (lignes 215-225)
{!user && (
  <Card>...<Button onClick={() => navigate('/')}>{l.joinSovereign}</Button></Card>
)}

// Lazy dialogs (lignes 230-245)
<Suspense fallback={null}>
  <MessageComposer isOpen={showComposer} ... recipient={profile} ... />
</Suspense>
<Suspense fallback={null}>
  <DealCardComposer open={showDealCard} ... celebrityId={profile.id} celebrityName={profile.username} />
</Suspense>
```

### FAITS CONFIRMÉS — `PublicProfile`

| Aspect | Détail |
|--------|--------|
| **Paramètre lu** | `params.username` (via `useParams`) — **attend `@` prefix** |
| **Validation** | `if (!username.startsWith('@'))` → `notFound` |
| **Requête Supabase** | `.eq('username', cleanUsername)` — **exact match, case-sensitive** |
| **Profil privé** | Si `!profile.is_public && !isOwnProfile` → page "profil privé" + bouton retour |
| **Partage** | `shareCardAsImage` (carte visuelle) + `copyUsername` — **PAS `buildShareLink`** |
| **URL partagée** | `window.location.origin}/@${profile.username}` — **construit manuellement** |
| **Actions** | Message (MessageComposer), Deal (DealCardComposer si celebrity), Join, Share, Copy |
| **Pas de `buildShareLink`** | N'utilise **jamais** `buildShareLink` ni `getPublicAppUrl` |

### FLUX `/:username` COMPLET
```
URL: /@omar (ou /sovereign/@omar)
    ↓
Route: /:username → PublicProfile
    ↓
PublicProfile: 
  - username = "@omar" (avec @)
  - cleanUsername = "omar"
  - supabase: .eq('username', 'omar')
    ↓
Affiche profil + boutons actions
    ↓
Partage: window.location.origin/@omar (manuel)
```

## MISE À JOUR INVESTIGATION — SYNTHÈSE COMPLÈTE

### A. ROUTES REACT ROUTER — **CONFIRMÉ EXHAUSTIF**

| Route | Composant | Paramètres | Fichier |
|-------|-----------|------------|---------|
| `/m/:token` | `RedeemManagerInvite` | `token` (path), `code` (query) | `App.tsx:62`, `RedeemManagerInvite.tsx` |
| `/s/:slug` | `SlugRedirect` | `slug` (path) | `App.tsx:63`, `SlugRedirect.tsx` |
| `/g/:slug` | `FanGroup` | `slug` (path) | `App.tsx:64` — **OBSOLÈTE** |
| `/:username` | `PublicProfile` | `username` (path, avec `@`) | `App.tsx:65`, `PublicProfile.tsx` |

### B. COMPOSANTS LISANT PARAMS — **CONFIRMÉ EXHAUSTIF**

| Composant | Paramètres | Méthode | Résolution |
|-----------|------------|---------|------------|
| `RedeemManagerInvite` | `token`, `code` | `useParams()`, `useSearchParams()` | Edge Function `redeem-manager-invite` |
| `SlugRedirect` | `slug` | `useParams()` | Supabase direct `.ilike('slug')` → redirect `/@username` |
| `PublicProfile` | `username` | `useParams()` | Supabase direct `.eq('username')` |

### C. `buildShareLink` / `getPublicAppUrl` — **USAGES CONFIRMÉS**

| Fichier | Fonction | Chemin | Contexte |
|---------|----------|--------|----------|
| `CustomLinkCard.tsx` | `buildShareLink` | `/s/${slug}` | Affichage + copie lien profil |
| `CustomLinkCard.tsx` | `getPublicAppUrl` | — | Extraction hostname pour UI |
| `InviteManagerDialog.tsx` | `buildShareLink` | `/m/${token}?code=${code}` | Partage natif + copie invitation |
| **AUTRES** | **AUCUN** | — | **Confirmé dans tous fichiers fournis** |

### D. CONSTRUCTION DIRECTE D'URLS — **CONFIRMÉ**

| Fichier | Construction | Méthode |
|---------|--------------|---------|
| `PublicProfile.tsx` | `window.location.origin}/@${username}` | Manuel (ligne ~150) |
| `SlugRedirect.tsx` | `navigate(\`/@${username}\`)` | React Router navigate |
| `RedeemManagerInvite.tsx` | `navigate(\`/?redirect=/m/${token}\`)` | React Router navigate |
| `CustomLinkCard.tsx` | `buildShareLink(\`/s/${slug}\`)` | Via fonction |
| `InviteManagerDialog.tsx` | `buildShareLink(\`/m/${token}?code=${code}\`)` | Via fonction |
| `appUrl.ts` | `window.location.origin` | Fallback `getPublicAppUrl` |

### E. LOGIQUE SERVEUR RÉSOLUTION — **CONFIRMÉ**

| Flux | Résolution | Table/Function | Clé |
|------|------------|----------------|-----|
| `/s/:slug` | `SlugRedirect` → Supabase `.ilike('slug')` | `profiles` | `slug` (case-insensitive) |
| `/m/:token?code=` | `RedeemManagerInvite` → Edge Function | `redeem-manager-invite` | `token` + `code` |
| `/:username` | `PublicProfile` → Supabase `.eq('username')` | `profiles` | `username` (exact, case-sensitive) |
| Slug update | `CustomLinkCard` → RPC | `set_profile_slug` | `slug` |

### F. HARD REFRESH / DEEP LINK — **ANALYSE FINALE**

| Composant | Fonctionne au hard refresh ? | Condition |
|-----------|------------------------------|-----------|
| `/m/:token?code=` | ✅ **OUI** | Route définie, composant charge, lit params, appelle Edge Function |
| `/s/:slug` | ✅ **OUI** | Route définie, `SlugRedirect` charge, requête Supabase, redirect |
| `/:username` | ✅ **OUI** | Route définie, `PublicProfile` charge, requête Supabase |

**MAIS — Liens partagés (`buildShareLink`) :**
- Génèrent `/s/...` et `/m/...` **SANS `BASE_PATH`**
- Si `BASE_PATH=/sovereign/` et `VITE_APP_BASE_URL=https://app.example.com`
- Lien généré : `https://app.example.com/s/omar`
- URL réelle : `https://app.example.com/sovereign/s/omar`
- **→ 404 AU HARD REFRESH** (sauf si `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` inclut le `BASE_PATH`)

### G. `BASE_PATH` DANS IMPLÉMENTATION — **ÉTAT FINAL**

| Couche | Gestion `BASE_PATH` |
|--------|---------------------|
| **Vite `base`** | ✅ `BASE_PATH` injecté via `process.env.BASE_PATH` |
| **React Router** | ✅ Routes montées sous `base` automatiquement |
| **Service Worker** | ✅ `scope: "/"` relatif à `base` |
| **`import.meta.env.BASE_URL`** | ✅ Disponible (Vite) — **NON UTILISÉ** |
| **`buildShareLink`** | ❌ **IGNORE `BASE_PATH`** — utilise seulement `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` |
| **`PublicProfile` partage** | ❌ **IGNORE `BASE_PATH`** — `window.location.origin` (inclut `BASE_PATH` si même origine) |
| **`SlugRedirect` redirect** | ✅ `navigate('/@user')` — relatif, géré par React Router |
| **`RedeemManagerInvite` redirect** | ✅ `navigate('/?redirect=/m/...')` — relatif |

### H. DUPLICATIONS / OBSOLÈTES / CONFLITS — **CONFIRMÉS EXHAUSTIFS**

| # | Problème | Preuve | Impact |
|---|----------|--------|--------|
| 1 | **Route `/g/:slug` active** | `App.tsx:64` | Conflit potentiel, code mort |
| 2 | **`BASE_PATH` vs `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` non synchronisés** | `vite.config.ts` + `appUrl.ts` | Liens partagés cassés en sous-chemin |
| 3 | **`buildShareLink` ignore `import.meta.env.BASE_URL`** | `appUrl.ts` | Incohérence routing vs liens |
| 4 | **`navigator.share` cassé en dev (localhost)** | `appUrl.ts` + `InviteManagerDialog.tsx` | Partage natif impossible dev |
| 5 | **`PublicProfile` construit URL manuellement** | `PublicProfile.tsx:150` | `window.location.origin/@user` — fonctionne mais incohérent |
| 6 | **Deux chemins vers profil public** | `/s/:slug` → redirect → `/:username` | Complexité inutile, double résolution |
| 7 | **`getPublicAppUrl` retourne `''` sur localhost** | `appUrl.ts:24-27` | `buildShareLink` → chemin relatif |
| 8 | **Aucune validation `path` dans `buildShareLink`** | `appUrl.ts:38` | Injection chemin possible |
| 9 | **`PublicProfile` n'utilise PAS `buildShareLink`** | `PublicProfile.tsx` — aucun import | Incohérence : partage manuel vs fonction centralisée |
| 10 | **`SlugRedirect` n'utilise PAS `buildShareLink`** | `SlugRedirect.tsx` — aucun import | Cohérent (ne génère pas de lien) |
| 11 | **`RedeemManagerInvite` n'utilise PAS `buildShareLink`** | `RedeemManagerInvite.tsx` — aucun import | Cohérent (ne génère pas de lien) |

## RÉSUMÉ FINAL : CONFIRMÉ / INCONNU / CONFLIT

### ✅ CONFIRMÉ (100% prouvé par fichiers fournis)

1. **Architecture routing complète** : 4 routes publiques définies dans `App.tsx`, 3 composants pages fournis et analysés
2. **Flux `/m/:token?code=`** : `RedeemManagerInvite` lit `token` (path) + `code` (query), appelle Edge Function `redeem-manager-invite`, valide, crée `manager_links`, bascule contexte via `switchCelebrity`
3. **Flux `/s/:slug`** : `SlugRedirect` lit `slug`, requête Supabase `.ilike('slug')`, redirect `navigate('/@username', { replace: true })` vers `PublicProfile`
4. **Flux `/:username`** : `PublicProfile` lit `username` (avec `@`), requête Supabase `.eq('username')`, gère public/privé, actions message/deal/partage
4. **Génération invitation** : `create-manager-invite` → `token` (16 chars) + `code` (8 chars), 15min expiry, stocké en base
5. **Résolution invitation** : `redeem-manager-invite` → valide `token`+`code`, protection brute-force, upsert `manager_links`, audit log
6. **`buildShareLink` usages exacts** : 3 appels totaux — `/s/*` (×2 dans `CustomLinkCard`), `/m/*?code=` (×1 dans `InviteManagerDialog`)
7. **`getPublicAppUrl` comportement exact** : `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` > `window.location.origin` (non-localhost) > `''` (localhost/SSR)
8. **`BASE_PATH` requis pour Vite `base`** — distinct de `VITE_APP_BASE_URL`, non injecté dans `buildShareLink`
9. **`PublicProfile` partage manuel** : `window.location.origin/@username` — **n'utilise pas `buildShareLink`**
10. **Route `/g/:slug` obsolète active** dans `App.tsx`

### ❓ INCONNU (non vérifiable sans fichiers manquants)

1. **`src/sw.ts`** — Comportement exact navigation fallback, caching stratégies pour `/s/*`, `/m/*`
2. **Valeurs réelles production** — `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` et `BASE_PATH` déployés
3. **RPC `set_profile_slug`** — Implémentation serveur (unicité, validation, etc.)
4. **`FanGroupsManager.tsx`** — S'il existe, usages résiduels `/g/*` ou `buildShareLink`

### ⚠️ CONFLITS / PROBLÈMES ARCHITECTURAUX PROUVÉS (11 identifiés)

| # | Conflit | Gravité | Preuve |
|---|---------|---------|--------|
| 1 | **Liens partagés cassés si `BASE_PATH` ≠ ''** | **CRITIQUE** | `buildShareLink` ignore `BASE_PATH` |
| 2 | **`navigator.share` cassé en dev** | **HAUTE** | `getPublicAppUrl()` → `''` sur localhost |
| 3 | **Deux sources URL publique non synchronisées** | **HAUTE** | `VITE_APP_BASE_URL` vs `BASE_PATH` |
| 4 | **`PublicProfile` duplique logique partage** | **MOYENNE** | `window.location.origin/@user` vs `buildShareLink` |
| 5 | **Route `/g/:slug` obsolète active** | **MOYENNE** | `App.tsx:64` |
| 6 | **Double résolution profil** (`/s/` → redirect → `/@`) | **MOYENNE** | `SlugRedirect` + `PublicProfile` |
| 7 | **Aucune validation entrée `buildShareLink`** | **MOYENNE** | `appUrl.ts:38` |
| 8 | **`getPublicAppUrl` type `string` mais peut être vide** | **FAIBLE** | TS strict désactivé |
| 9 | **PWA scope gère `BASE_PATH` mais liens non** | **FAIBLE** | `vite.config.ts` + `appUrl.ts` |
| 10 | **`SlugRedirect` utilise `.ilike` (case-insensitive)** | **FAIBLE** | `SlugRedirect.tsx` — `PublicProfile` utilise `.eq` (case-sensitive) |
| 11 | **Redirection `/s/` → `/@` perd `BASE_PATH` si mal configuré** | **FAIBLE** | `navigate('/@user')` relatif — OK si React Router monté sous `base` |

```typescript
/**
 * Public, shareable base URL for Sovereign.
 * Priority:
 *   1. VITE_APP_BASE_URL — explicit build/deploy-time override (custom domain)
 *   2. window.location.origin — the actual domain the app is running on.
 *      We exclude localhost/127.0.0.1 since those aren't publicly reachable.
 */

function envBaseUrl(): string | null {
  const raw = (import.meta as any)?.env?.VITE_APP_BASE_URL;
  if (typeof raw === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(raw.trim())) {
    return raw.trim().replace(/\/$/, '');
  }
  return null;
}

export function getPublicAppUrl(): string {
  const override = envBaseUrl();
  if (override) return override;

  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return '';

  const origin = window.location.origin;

  // Localhost is not publicly reachable — skip it.
  if (origin.includes('localhost') || origin.includes('127.0.0.1')) {
    return '';
  }

  return origin;
}

/** Build a full shareable link to an in-app path (path must start with "/"). */
export function buildShareLink(path: string): string {
  const base = getPublicAppUrl().replace(/\/$/, '');
  const p = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;
  return base ? `${base}${p}` : p;
}
```

```
/**
 * Public, shareable base URL for Sovereign.
 * Priority:
 *   1. VITE_APP_BASE_URL — explicit build/deploy-time override (custom domain)
 *   2. window.location.origin — the actual domain the app is running on.
 */

function envBaseUrl(): string | null {
  const raw = (import.meta as any)?.env?.VITE_APP_BASE_URL;
  if (typeof raw === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(raw.trim())) {
    return raw.trim().replace(/\/$/, '');
  }
  return null;
}

export function getPublicAppUrl(): string {
  const override = envBaseUrl();
  if (override) return override;

  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return '';

  // In browser, always return a valid origin (including localhost for dev).
  // This ensures buildShareLink produces absolute URLs even in local development.
  return window.location.origin;
}

/**
 * Returns the public origin (protocol + host + port) without any path.
 * Uses VITE_APP_BASE_URL when available, otherwise derives from window.location.
 * Safe fallback for SSR and edge cases.
 */
export function getPublicAppOrigin(): string {
  const override = envBaseUrl();
  if (override) {
    try {
      return new URL(override).origin;
    } catch {
      // fall through to window.location.origin
    }
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    return window.location.origin;
  }

  // SSR fallback — empty string indicates no public origin available.
  return '';
}

/** Build a full shareable link to an in-app path (path must start with "/"). */
export function buildShareLink(path: string): string {
  const publicUrl = getPublicAppUrl().replace(/\/$/, '');
  const basePath = (import.meta as any)?.env?.BASE_URL ?? '/';
  const normalizedBasePath = basePath.replace(/\/$/, '');
  const p = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;

  // Combine: publicUrl + basePath + path, avoiding duplicate slashes.
  const combinedPath = normalizedBasePath ? `${normalizedBasePath}${p}` : p;
  return publicUrl ? `${publicUrl}${combinedPath}` : combinedPath;
}
```

```
/**
 * Public, shareable base URL for Sovereign.
 * Priority:
 *   1. VITE_APP_BASE_URL — explicit build/deploy-time override (custom domain)
 *   2. window.location.origin — the actual domain the app is running on.
 */

function envBaseUrl(): string | null {
  const raw = (import.meta as any)?.env?.VITE_APP_BASE_URL;
  if (typeof raw === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(raw.trim())) {
    return raw.trim().replace(/\/$/, '');
  }
  return null;
}

export function getPublicAppUrl(): string {
  const override = envBaseUrl();
  if (override) return override;

  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return '';

  // In browser, always return a valid origin (including localhost for dev).
  // This ensures buildShareLink produces absolute URLs even in local development.
  return window.location.origin;
}

/**
 * Returns the public origin (protocol + host + port) without any path.
 * Uses VITE_APP_BASE_URL when available, otherwise derives from window.location.
 * Safe fallback for SSR and edge cases.
 */
export function getPublicAppOrigin(): string {
  const override = envBaseUrl();
  if (override) {
    try {
      return new URL(override).origin;
    } catch {
      // fall through to window.location.origin
    }
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    return window.location.origin;
  }

  // SSR fallback — empty string indicates no public origin available.
  return '';
}

/** Build a full shareable link to an in-app path (path must start with "/"). */
export function buildShareLink(path: string): string {
  const publicUrl = getPublicAppUrl().replace(/\/$/, '');
  const basePath = (import.meta as any)?.env?.BASE_URL ?? '/';
  const normalizedBasePath = basePath.replace(/\/$/, '');
  const p = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;

  // Prevent duplication: if publicUrl already ends with the base path (case-insensitive),
  // do not append it again. This handles cases where VITE_APP_BASE_URL already includes
  // the deployment subpath (e.g. https://app.example.com/sovereign).
  const publicUrlLower = publicUrl.toLowerCase();
  const basePathLower = normalizedBasePath.toLowerCase();
  const hasBasePathSuffix = basePathLower !== '' && publicUrlLower.endsWith(basePathLower);

  const combinedPath = hasBasePathSuffix ? p : (normalizedBasePath ? `${normalizedBasePath}${p}` : p);
  return publicUrl ? `${publicUrl}${combinedPath}` : combinedPath;
}
```
